question: Can the unchanged P26 export, S1 training and offline comparison obey the existing eight-hour D allocation and global48-hour limit even if internal GPU progress stalls?
hypothesis: An external CPU supervisor can enforce a fixed owned-child deadline and honest union accounting without changing D001 science. Uninterruptible OS/device states may still prevent confirmed exit.

sources.sections: Popen.poll/wait, explicit timeout cleanup, terminate/kill and returncode
sources.consequence: Reuse reviewed exact-child identity and bounded TERM/KILL; file logs avoid pipe backpressure. Confirm termination before closing intervals.
Fix admission-relative deadline; current D/global remainder may shorten but never extend it.
Admit and close under the same shared ledger lock; reject open intervals and count nested D003/D001 device time once.
An internal between-operation check cannot enforce a deadline while a synchronization stalls. Keep an external CPU parent without changing scientific precision, execution mode or hardware.

sources.sections: Frozen export/S1/evaluation protocol and eight-hour resources
sources.consequence: Use the already-approved stage commands and cumulative eight-hour allocation. Current gpu_run/budget_remaining enforces only shared48hours; the external wrapper must also enforce D allocation.
Inherit unchanged owned-process handling; focused CPU fixtures verify D-specific routing/accounting without claiming GPU-stall recovery.

differences: Operational wrapper only around unchanged D001 commands, in isolated ignored helper files. No new missions, collection, s0 retraining, S1 recipe changes, planner settings, thresholds, model or numerical-policy changes. Add frozen input/output hashes at admission/completion; no historical full-file binding is claimed for previously unhashed prepared features.
contrary_evidence: TERM/KILL cannot guarantee termination of an uninterruptible kernel process. A killed stage may have only partial track files or an older atomic S1 checkpoint; such evidence remains incomplete. Process/accounting checks do not establish track quality, predictor validity or generalization.

protocol.science: Exact existing D001 commands from RUNBOOK. Fixed prepared corpus, original feature index and frozen s0; S1 uses configs/object/m5.yaml and seed0; comparison uses original M5 and reviewed selected S1. No automatic retry/resume/review/successor.
protocol.order: Require reviewed n3seed0 core planning/probes for L0/L1/O0/O1 and slot binding before first P26 GPU stage, plus existing D001 adapter and D002 full legacy reviews. Valid measured-negative science remains admissible. Export review and actual D003 export operational review precede S1; reviewed selected S1 and its operational result precede comparison.
protocol.admission: Clean checkout, exact D003/D001 record/software/source/config hashes, fresh per-stage substantive consultation binding exact input files and prior reviews. Require no active repository trainer or GPU compute process, no open ledger interval and no reused output directories/partial prior exports. Never signal unrelated processes.
protocol.inputs: Bind prepared600train/100val metadata/data plus packed arrays, original feature index and selected feature files for export, frozen s0 checkpoint/config, existing registered maze files, and stage-specific reviewed tracks/rasters/config or selected S1/M5 artifacts. Reconcile original prepared feature-index digest and unit identities. Capture current file bytes before each actual stage without claiming earlier checks bound all bytes.
protocol.allocation: Union elapsed rows; global48hours counts all intervals; D8hours counts D001/D002/D003 GPU rows (D002 CPU regression has none). Do not charge B/C or validation reserve. Work seconds=min(global_remaining,D_remaining)-45cleanup. No additional allowance; no reset between stages.
protocol.supervision: Parent imports no Torch. ExactPID/create-time/argv/canonicalcwd through unchanged A016 wait/stop. One file-logged child; fixed monotonic deadline plus current ledger remainders. TERM30seconds then KILL10seconds,45second cleanup reserve. Keep final atomic checkpoints/partial tracks; updates since last save may be lost.
protocol.closure: Only own D003 outer and canonical matching D001 child interval, match manifest run_id, reject historical/ambiguous/mismatched rows. Close only after confirmed terminal child; unconfirmed exit keeps ledger open. Preserve technical/budget outcomes separately from scientific negatives.
protocol.artifacts: Keep scientific outputs at D001/corpus/track_run,D001/s1,D001/comparison. Operational results under D003/runs/STAGE bind child result/manifest and produced track/index/raster or checkpoint/log/comparison artifacts after confirmed exit. Rehash preregistered inputs to detect mutation. Each actual scientific and operational outcome needs substantive review before dependent work.
protocol.checks: CPU temporary-ledger tests for nested union, D/global exhaustion and cap, open-interval refusal, canonical own-only closure, live/historical/ambiguous/mismatched child rejection; exact three-stage argv; input and preconsultation completeness/staleness; known stage-parent identities; unchanged inherited sources and shared ledger; source syntax and one owned CPU normal/deadline pair. No actual P26 GPU case before n3 core reviews.

success: Scoped CPU verification passes and later actual operations remain within existing budgets or preserve an explicit unconfirmed terminal state with open accounting. No scientific performance gate is implied.
stop: Reject stale/missing lineage, input/source drift, reused output, active GPU/trainer or exhausted allocation. Stop only owned child at deadline; preserve every partial artifact. Do not modify live B003/C005 source or any go2nav scientific implementation.

resources.allocation: Existing cumulative D8hours within shared48hours, not new allowance
resources.training_device: dedicated_gpu in unchanged D001 child; supervisor CPU only
